pk_contract: {form} completed and initialed on every page
pk_letter: Pre-approval letter at the offer price, not the max
pk_pof_cash: Proof of funds: a recent statement in the buyer's name
pk_letter_cap: Letter at up to {cap}, the escalation cap
pk_funds_gap: Proof of funds for deposit, closing costs and appraisal gap
pk_funds: Proof of funds for deposit and closing costs
pk_source: Source-of-funds note if the account is new
pk_insurance: Homeowners insurance quote for this address
pk_agency_fl: Brokerage relationship disclosure signed: transaction broker or single agent
pk_bb: Buyer-broker agreement signed; compensation request matches
pk_wire_note: Deposit wiring instructions only by phone from the escrow agent
pk_never: Personal letter, photos or buyer background
